title: SolveSheep warm workshop
brief: A warm, exploratory math-practice interface for curious learners and olympiad problem solvers, with personal progress states, skill practice signals, tag-built training sets, a light/dark theme, and a native-masonry-ready problem library. New status and skill data are illustrative because persistence is outside this UI-design scope.

artboards.title: Training workshop
artboards.tradeoff: Puts one active problem and its solve/give-up choice first; gives less space to browsing the full library.

artboards.title: Practice profile
artboards.tradeoff: Makes skill signals and personal problem states visible together; the radar chart needs careful caveats and enough real tagged attempts.

artboards.title: Search in observatory dark mode
artboards.tradeoff: Shows dense, scannable results and a distinctive dark theme; native grid lanes need a responsive grid fallback where unsupported.
